title: Your own ssh alias stopped working -- "Bad owner or permissions"
description_md:
You (the `trainee` user) have an `apphost` alias set up in your own `~/.ssh/config` for the app server, but running `ssh apphost` now fails outright -- it doesn't even try to connect, and it's not sshd on the other end rejecting anything. Something local to your own account changed. Figure out why `ssh` itself is refusing to use your config file, and get `ssh apphost` working again.

You're done when `ssh apphost 'echo SSH_OK'` prints `SSH_OK`.
